assertions.name: sigma_avg_equals_sigma_minus_half_hq_identity
assertions.source: In any Hecke representation satisfying (sigma - q)(sigma + q^-1) = 0, the flavor-blind color-averaged generator (sigma + sigma^-1)/2 equals sigma - (h_q/2)*I identically.

assertions.name: bring_color_tube_pn_factor_matches_closed_form
assertions.source: closed_form_tau_M.closed_form_ratio(1, 1, q0, 'bring_color_weighted') equals z(q0) - h(q0)*(1/2 - delta(q0)/4) where delta(q0) is the light (u, d) substrate split from prop:flavor-split-substrate.

assertions.name: isotypic_weights_normalized_and_charge_symmetric
assertions.source: A_5 isotypic weights on the 9 color pairs sum to 1 in both I=1 (T_1) and I=0 (A (+) H) channels, and assign identical weights to pp and nn.

assertions.name: c_swap_is_charge_conjugation_involution_preserving_generator
assertions.source: C in conj:c-from-color-flavor-swap is discrete charge conjugation (C^2 = id, eps C-invariant over all 144 nucleon/color cells, and sigma^(CF1, CF2) = sigma^(F1, F2) to working precision).

assertions.name: charm_quark_projection_onto_nucleon_color_sheets_is_zero
assertions.source: Every nucleon/antinucleon color-sheet triple in {p, n, pbar, nbar} takes values in the light doublet {u, d, ubar, dbar}; Flavor.charm (heavy meson dressing sector) has zero occurrences in the 3-strand inter-nucleon additive channel.

description: Bean qou-q6lw (Epic qou-8lxd). Verifies at 50+ dps that the inter-nucleon additive term is a 3-strand COLOR-SHEET channel term (gluon exchange across the 9 color pairs (c1, c2) in {r, g, b}^2 with leading flavor-blind average sigma_avg = sigma - (h_q/2)*1 and subleading light-(u,d) Bring color-tube correction +h_q*delta/4), that the 'c' in c-from-color-flavor-swap is discrete charge conjugation C (u <-> ubar, d <-> dbar, C^2 = id) rather than the charm quark, and that Flavor.charm lives in the heavy-meson mass dressing sector with identically zero projection onto the 3-strand (u, d) nucleon additive channel.

c_from_color_flavor_swap_check.meaning_of_C: discrete charge conjugation u <-> ubar, d <-> dbar on the 3 color sheets (NOT charm quark)
